title: Paid Before Ship Gate
summary: Stop unpaid orders before packing with a local payment checkpoint.
user: A tiny seller that quotes or takes orders on flexible terms but needs a visible, intentional rule for which orders must be paid before they are packed or dispatched.
smallest_useful_product: Local order-status board that imports orders and payment confirmations, flags hold-until-paid rules by customer or order, logs a named override reason, and exports a pack list.
success_measure: No held order is dispatched without recorded payment or a named override, while pack-list preparation takes under five minutes per batch.
constraints: Payment imports are sensitive; support redacted CSV columns and device encryption; do not make creditworthiness claims or automatically contact customers.
